outsiders.name: Alex Veremeyenko
outsiders.text:
Found a GitHub repo that does Claude Code’s job without for free.

Yesterday Accenture told staff it will only pay for $29 a month of Claude.

Some of them were spending $1,000.

It’s called OpenCode.

It’s an open-source AI coding agent with over 214,000 stars, and it’s the free version of the tool they’re about to lose.

The idea is simple. It works like Claude Code, in your terminal or as a desktop app, but you choose the model.

A few things caught my eye.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now free inside it.

You can still plug in Claude, GPT or Gemini when you need them, or run a local model on your own machine.

It runs on Mac, Windows and Linux, and over 1,000 people have contributed to it.

The code is open, so you can see exactly what it does with your files.

When your company caps your AI budget, open source is the tool that doesn’t get cut.
